description: Latest-snapshot rank-health board across the active projects the caller can access in an organization: one row per brand (share of voice, mention rate, average mention position, positivity, tracked-query count in total and per engine family: AI, SERP, Shopping) ranked by share of voice, plus an organization-level aggregate. This is a current-state snapshot and takes NO date window; for date-ranged comparison, call the per-project tools (e.g. get_project_rank_tracking_stats) for each project id returned here. Answers questions like "give me a company-wide summary of share of voice and sentiment across all my projects".
name: get_organization_overview
title: Organization brand overview
